subject: registration open for NIMBLE short course, June 3-4, 2020 at UC Berkeley

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: registration open for NIMBLE short course, June 3-4, 2020 at UC Berkeley
parts:
All,

Registration is now open for a two-day training workshop on NIMBLE, June 3-4, 2020 in Berkeley, California. Details are available here: https://r-nimble.org/registration-open-for-nimble-short-course-june-3-4-2020-at-uc-berkeley.

To register, please go here: https://na.eventscloud.com/528790. Registration is $230 (regular) or $115 (student).

We have also reserved a block of rooms on campus for $137 per night, including breakfast and lunch. To reserve a room, go here: https://na.eventscloud.com/528792.

-Chris
